visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A bulldog avatar, animated with human-like proportions, stands in a brightly lit studio environment. It wears a white tank top, green shorts with white stripes, and a tan bucket hat. In front of it sits a black professional microphone on a stand, and a blue retail box for the 'Wave:3' microphone is placed to the right. A large computer monitor in the background displays a complex audio mixing interface with the Elgato logo at the top. (2) The scene shifts to a different hardware setup. The bulldog is now positioned behind an Elgato Facecam 4K, which is mounted on a stand. The background monitor displays a high-definition close-up feed of the bulldog's face, demonstrating the camera's capability. The lighting is crisp, highlighting the textures of the dog's skin and clothing. (3) The dog interacts with a Stream Deck XL, a control panel with numerous glowing LCD buttons. As its paw presses the keys, the monitor in the background switches from a video editing timeline to a Google search homepage. The retail box for the Stream Deck XL is visible on the right side of the desk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic BGM starts with a bright synthesizer melody and a driving 4/4 electronic drum beat. No human speech is present. A rhythmic percussive 'tap' SFX, resembling a soft impact on plastic, is heard four times, perfectly synchronized with the musical beat and the character's visual tapping. (2) The electronic music continues uninterrupted at the same BPM. A distinct mechanical 'click' sound, followed by a faint high-frequency whir, suggests the adjustment of a camera lens or mechanical dial. The audio track is extremely clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio and no environmental floor noise. (3) The music maintains its energetic loop. A series of rapid, hollow plastic clicking SFX occur in quick succession, simulating the tactile feedback of pressing buttons on a control panel. A subtle digital 'ding' or UI chime is audible at the end of the sequence, signaling a successful interaction.
